home.title: Full_Stack Developer
home.description: Full-stack developer turning ideas into reliable, well-crafted web products. I work with React, TypeScript, Node.js and cloud tooling to ship clean code and great user experiences. Open to freelance projects and new opportunities, so get in touch.

header.title: Changelog of my experiences
header.description: Here is a timeline of my professional journey and key experiences throughout the years.

background.intro: Before I wrote code, I spent years in hospitality, from the kitchen line to the front counter at fast food chains. It was fast, loud and unforgiving, and it taught me most of what I know about working with people.

cook.title: Cook
cook.summary: Prepared and assembled orders on the line, kept stations stocked and followed strict food safety routines while tickets kept coming in.

service.title: Service
service.summary: Took orders, handled payments and dealt with guests directly, including the ones who were already unhappy when they walked in.

barman.title: Barman
barman.summary: Prepared drinks, managed the bar area and coordinated with the kitchen to keep the service running smoothly.

lead.title: Shift lead
lead.summary: Coordinated the team during busy hours, trained new staff and made the quick calls that kept the shift running.

education.intro: I came to software through economics. The first part of my education taught me how to think about systems and data, and the second taught me how to build with them.

diploma.title: High school diploma in Economics
diploma.summary: My first structured introduction to how money, businesses and institutions work, with economics and business subjects alongside the core curriculum.

university.title: B.Sc. Economics, Markets and Institutions
university.summary: Three-year program in economics, markets and institutions, of which I completed two years. It gave me a solid grounding in quantitative methods and in how markets and policy decisions work, and it trained me to break complex problems down and back my reasoning with data.

bootcamp.title: Full-stack web development bootcamp
bootcamp.summary: A 6-month intensive course in full-stack web development, with a focus on React, Node.js and TypeScript. This is where I learned to build software from scratch and ship it to users.
highlights: Working in English with an international team
Shipping a project end to end

experience.intro: I build software for robots that make drinks. My work sits where software meets hardware: interfaces that clients and operators use every day to run real machines in real venues.
experience.listHint: Pick a card to see the details.

platform.title: Robot management software
platform.summary: The frontend of a complex management platform that lets our clients interact with the robot and its hardware at every level.
highlights: Built the frontend of a large, multi-level management platform
Worked side by side with a team of experienced designers
Turned hardware actions and states into clear, usable interfaces

sites.title: Websites and presentations
sites.summary: Beyond the core platform, I took care of several frontend projects for the company and for connected companies.

design.title: A product built from scratch
design.summary: One project was designed entirely by me, then built end to end on the frontend and shipped together with the backend team.
highlights: Owned the UI and UX design from a blank page
Worked closely with the backend team through development and deployment

deploy.title: International deployments
deploy.summary: I took part in installing the software on site, working directly on the hardware.
highlights: Deployments in the USA and Europe
Hands-on work directly on the machines
Handled the communication between software and hardware on site
